turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: First, inspect the clamping arm bodies for any cracks or bending deformation. Next, check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. Finally, inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. 2. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. 3. Inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've completed all three checks. The arm bodies look good with no cracks or deformation, the pivot pins are solid, and the pad faces are within acceptable wear limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. 2. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. 3. Inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

turns.utterance: Cracks, deformation or severe wear on clamping arms?

turns.utterance: Replace the return springs and check the actuator seals.

turns.utterance: Reverify clamping force after spring replacement.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The clamping force is now back within specification after the spring replacement.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify clamping force after spring replacement

turns.utterance: Clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the pad surface roughness and flatness measurements are both within acceptable limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

turns.utterance: Open and close sensor positions within plus or minus 0.3 millimeters of nominal?

turns.utterance: The sensor positions are out of tolerance. The open position is off by about half a millimeter.

ground_truth.node_text: Open and close sensor positions within ±0.3 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reposition the sensors and reteach the open and close positions in the programmable controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Reposition sensors and reteach open/close positions in programmable controller

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sensors repositioned and new positions have been taught into the controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Reposition sensors and reteach open/close positions in programmable controller

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify sensor positions after reteach.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify sensor positions after reteach

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The sensor positions are now reading correctly within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify sensor positions after reteach

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 millimeter limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 mm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The pivot pin itself looks fine, but I'm seeing scoring and heat discoloration on the bushing bore that's not mentioned in any of these checks.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the radial clearance measurements are all well within the 0.05 millimeter limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 mm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

ground_truth.node_text: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all grease nipples accepted lubricant properly and the pivots have been greased according to spec.

ground_truth.node_text: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: All 20 cycles completed without missed clamp or timeout?

turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing a sensor signal dropout on cycle 14. The clamp timed out waiting for the close confirmation.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Investigate the cycle fault and check sensor and actuator timing.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Found a loose sensor cable connection. I've secured it and verified the signal is now stable.

turns.utterance: Complete the following steps: Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. Then attempt to move the reference part by applying a lateral force by hand. Finally, confirm the part does not move and record the clamping force reading.

turns.utterance: Reference part held without movement during simulated cut?

turns.utterance: Yes, the part remained completely stationary under the applied force. The clamp is holding securely.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part held without movement during simulated cut?

turns.utterance: Log the clamp force and cycle data, then update the service record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data has been logged and the service record is updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log clamp force and cycle data, update service record

turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The clamping unit has passed all diagnostic checks and is ready to return to service.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, marking the unit as operational.
